# altitude

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:axisAltitude`](gmeow-axisAltitude.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/axisAltitude>
- **Category:** individual
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)

The vertical axis above a reference datum — mean sea level, ground level, or another vertical reference surface. Used for aviation and terrestrial elevation bounds.
